title: Coverings by w-contractible affines
statement:
Every object $U$ of $X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ has a covering $\{\operatorname{Spec}D_i\to U\}$ in
$X_{\mathrm{proét}}$ with every $D_i$ w-contractible. Each $\operatorname{Spec}D_i\to U$ can
be taken to factor as $\operatorname{Spec}D_i\to\operatorname{Spec}B_i\subset U$, with
$\operatorname{Spec}B_i$ an affine open of $U$ and $B_i\to D_i$ faithfully flat and
ind-étale.

proof.text: Take the Mathlib affine-open cover A of U.left. For every chart ring A.X j apply the already proved exists_isWContractibleRing, the declaration attached to [sk-thm-pe-wc-cover]. It gives D j in the same universe, its commutative ring and algebra structures, ind-etaleness, faithful flatness and w-contractibility. Let phi j be its algebra map. Eliminate these existential witnesses inside the theorem proof; no definition chooses data from an unproved existence theorem.

For phi j, use the closed source-library RingHom.IndEtale.weaklyEtale and WeaklyEtale.Spec_iff API for [sk-def-pe-morphisms] to make Spec.map (phi j) weakly etale. Faithful flatness makes it surjective, by the flat-and-surjective spectrum criterion [lem-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-surjective-spectrum]. Since both spectra are affine, each singleton belongs to the proetale precoverage [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering] by Hom.singleton_mem_propQCPrecoverage. These are specializations of the existing source and Mathlib APIs; no general comparison theorem is assumed.

Weaken the affine-open cover to the proetale precoverage using Mathlib zariskiPrecoverage_le_propQCPrecoverage, which uses that open immersions are etale [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-etale] and hence weakly etale. Bind this cover with the singleton covers of the previous step. Cover.bind gives a covering B of U.left, indexed by the small dependent sum of the affine-cover indices and PUnit. By weak-etale composition [lem-weil-pbc-weakly-etale-composition-base-change], B.f i followed by U.hom defines a site object W i [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and B.f i defines its map to U. Mapping the presieve along the forgetful functor gives exactly B.presieve, whose membership is B.mem0. At i = (j, star), W i has underlying scheme Spec (D j); choose the identity isomorphism, A.X j, phi j and the affine-open inclusion A.f j. The factorization is Category.id_comp. This supplies all requested witnesses and keeps the finite refinement condition through precoverage composition, without indexing by all affine opens.

lean.statement: theorem exists_wContractible_affine_cover (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt) : ∃ (I : Type u) (W : I → X.ProEt) (f : ∀ i : I, W i ⟶ U), Presieve.ofArrows W f ∈ precoverage X U ∧ ∀ i : I, ∃ (D : CommRingCat.{u}), IsWContractibleRing D ∧ ∃ (e : Spec D ≅ (W i).left) (B : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : B ⟶ D) (j : Spec B ⟶ U.left), IsOpenImmersion j ∧ φ.hom.FaithfullyFlat ∧ φ.hom.IndEtale ∧ e.hom ≫ (f i).left = Spec.map φ ≫ j
